subject: ACME Health — SOC 2 discovery and evidence request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME Health — SOC 2 discovery and evidence request

Thanks for your time today, Jane — great conversation. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps below.

Key pain points / goals (what I heard):
- Need an inference provider with SOC 2 Type II controls in place and clear evidence for audit (audit logs, change control).
- Strong data retention and deletion controls — ability to set retention per-tenant and confirm deletion traces.
- Requirement for a DPA and support for customer-managed KMS (HSM/KMS integrations).
- Pen test evidence and recent vulnerability remediation timeline for third-party review.
- Low-latency inference with predictable SLAs for production workloads (primary engineering ask).

Summary of what Redwood can provide (high-level):
- SOC 2 Type II report (summary + & redwood-soc2-summary.pdf attached) and mapping to ACME control objectives.
- Audit log features: token-level request logs, admin access audit trail, and exportable CSVs for 90/365-day retention.
- DPA + support for KMS integrations (we can support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS or Vault).
- Pen test report: high-level findings and remediation status (pen-test-summary.pdf attached).

Action items / next steps (owners & tentative dates):
1) I will send our standard SOC 2 evidence pack and a short questionnaire by EOD — Marissa (today).
2) ACME to confirm specific retention window and any special deletion certification (Jane/Tom) — target Mar 10.
3) Share DPA and list of required contractual amendments (I will loop Legal) — Marissa (Mar 8).
4) Schedule a technical follow-up to review audit logs, KMS setup, and pen test details with Rishi (30–45 min) — propose week of Mar 8.

Attachments included: ACME_SOC2_Questions.xlsx (questions for discovery), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, pen-test-summary.pdf.

Please reply with any corrections to the notes above and confirm availability for the tech review.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>

Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME Health — SOC 2 discovery and evidence request

Marissa — thanks for the thorough recap. This matches our notes. A few clarifications:

1) Retention: our baseline requirement is 365 days for audit logs, plus a 7-year archival option for legal holds.
2) DPA: we already have a template DPA; will need to see Redwood's standard terms and any deviations.
3) Pen test: we need a redacted copy of the most recent pen test and a short remediation timeline we can show our InfoSec leadership.

We can confirm the retention policy and the list of required contract points by Mar 10. Tech review: Tom and I are available Tue Mar 9 between 10:00–12:00 PT or Wed Mar 10 14:00–16:00 PT.

I'll upload our procurement questionnaire to the shared Drive and add comments — will notify you when done.

Best,
Jane
Director, Information Security
ACME Health

Jane / team — appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps from my side ahead of Tue Mar 9 10:00 PT slot (we tentatively booked 10:00–10:45 PT):

1) I'll bring a short slide deck describing our KMS options, an example terraform snippet for key binding, and a sample audit-log export demonstrating fields and retention metadata.
2) I'll attach a redacted pen test summary (pen-test-summary.pdf) and provide a one-page remediation timeline during the call.
3) Marissa / Neha — please add the DPA and any contract asks to the HubSpot deal so Legal can action.
